# Editorial Wellness Journey

Skin ID: `editorial-wellness`

Public name: Editorial Wellness Journey

Mood: premium editorial wellness, calm, refined, human.

Best-fit niches: lifestyle, gut health, sleep, stress, PCOS when coach copy supports it, general wellness.

Visual metaphor: a premium wellness magazine feature page for a coach.

Structure:
- Hero: editorial title block with coach portrait treatment.
- Background: ivory paper/noise texture with soft gradient wash.
- Cards: thin-line cream cards, low shadow, border glow.
- CTA: refined teal/champagne invitation.
- Navbar: thin editorial glass nav.
- Sticky CTA: elegant invitation bar.
- Bonus: premium booklet/video/toolkit inserts.
- FAQ: line accordion.
- Media: magazine portrait frame, cutout if available, framed fallback otherwise.
- Motion: slow fade, no heavy motion.
- Mobile: title first, portrait second, single-column editorial rows.

Difference from default: not glass-dashboard-like; uses editorial portrait, line sections, paper texture, insert cards, and line FAQ.

Must not change: CTA href, Google Form behavior, legal/support links, analytics, bonus service names, FAQ data, inspect slot keys.
